2607.11117.title: MusicMark: A Robust Generative Watermarking Framework for Music Generation
2607.11117.paper_summary: AI music generation has rapidly advanced alongside commercial platforms, raising the need for reliable watermarking for provenance and attribution. However, existing audio watermarking research has largely focused on speech, and applying speech-oriented methods to music is challenging due to music's complex structure and rich acoustic texture. Most existing methods are post-hoc, adding imperceptible perturbations after generation rather than embedding watermarks as part of the content. This makes them fragile under transformations and especially vulnerable to neural codec re-synthesis, which can discard imperceptible residual signals. Moreover, since generation and watermarking are decoupled, the watermarking step can be bypassed or omitted, weakening provenance guarantees. To address these issues, we propose MusicMark, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first generative watermarking framework for music. Specifically, MusicMark embeds watermark messages into the semantic latent space during generation, incorporating the watermark as part of the musical content and ensuring robustness against diverse attacks, particularly neural codec re-synthesis. To this end, we introduce a watermark adapter into a diffusion-based generation model to embed watermark messages across denoising steps. The adapter and detector are trained with a joint objective that preserves fidelity by constraining watermarked latents close to their unwatermarked reference latents, while improving robustness through attack augmentations. Experiments demonstrate that MusicMark substantially outperforms post-hoc baselines across diverse attacks including neural codec re-synthesis, while maintaining comparable generation quality. We further introduce a cover-song attack, converting the singing voice while preserving musical content, and show that MusicMark remains more robust than post-hoc methods.
2607.11117.paper_summary_zh: AI 音樂生成隨著商業平台的快速發展而迅速進步，這提高了對於來源和歸屬的可靠水印技術的需求。<lb/>然而，現有的音頻水印研究主要集中在語音上，將以語音為導向的方法應用於音樂是具有挑戰性的，因為音樂的結構複雜且聲學質感豐富。<lb/>大多數現有方法是事後處理，僅在生成後添加不可察覺的擾動，而不是將水印嵌入內容的一部分。<lb/>這使得它們在轉換過程中脆弱，特別容易受到神經編解碼器重合成的影響，因為這可能會丟棄不可察覺的殘餘信號。<lb/>此外，由於生成和水印步驟是解耦的，水印步驟可以被繞過或省略，從而削弱了來源保證。<lb/>為了解決這些問題，我們提出了 MusicMark，據我們所知，這是首個針對音樂的生成水印框架。<lb/>具體而言，MusicMark 在生成過程中將水印消息嵌入語義潛在空間，將水印作為音樂內容的一部分，並確保對各種攻擊的穩健性，特別是神經編解碼器重合成。<lb/>為此，我們在基於擴散的生成模型中引入了一個水印適配器，以便在去噪步驟中嵌入水印消息。<lb/>適配器和檢測器以一個共同的目標進行訓練，通過將水印潛在向量約束在其未水印參考潛在向量附近來保持保真度，同時通過攻擊增強來提高穩健性。<lb/>實驗表明，MusicMark 在各種攻擊（包括神經編解碼器重合成）中顯著超越了事後基準，同時保持了相當的生成質量。<lb/>我們進一步引入了一種翻唱攻擊，轉換歌聲的同時保留音樂內容，並顯示 MusicMark 的穩健性仍然優於事後方法。
